description.value: Mattu's Coffee & Tea is a long-standing neighborhood café in Langley Township's Willoughby Town Centre, offering globally sourced gourmet coffees, fine teas, breakfast wraps, pastries, and brownies over more than 20 years of operation. The spacious interior with ample seating serves as a popular study and remote-work retreat, and the café doubles as a curated shop selling teapot sets, coffee mugs, and brewing accessories. Friendly, personalized service from regulars-facing baristas gives it a genuine community-hub feel rather than a transient coffee stop.
